advantages: Ensures every element in the provided array is a `WeakMap` instance.
Returns `false` for empty arrays, preventing accidental acceptance of “no data” as valid input.
Useful as a guard before performing `WeakMap`-specific operations on all items.

parameterDescriptions.array: The array to check for `WeakMap` instances.

shortDescription: `areWeakMaps` checks whether a value is a non-empty array where every element is a `WeakMap`, returning `true` only in that case and `false` otherwise.
typeScriptHint: Use `areWeakMaps` to validate unknown input before treating it as a non-empty `WeakMap[]`; it returns `false` for empty arrays.
useCase: Validate runtime data (e.g., parsed JSON, plugin inputs, or loosely typed configuration) to ensure it is a non-empty array of `WeakMap` instances before iterating and calling `WeakMap` methods; returns `false` when any element is not a `WeakMap` or when the array is empty.
